scope: All 118 unique maintained official URLs referenced by Platform, premium-product, Forwarder and SOAR data or the new Python 2.13 evidence, plus bounded current release, upgrade, compatibility, receiver, runtime, security and SOAR claims.

sourceInventory.method: Each maintained URL was fetched directly on 2026-10-06. Current product hubs, release-note indexes, Splunkbase listings, the advisory index and official GitHub Releases endpoints were also checked for newer identifiers. Successful retrieval was not treated as claim verification.
sourceInventory.outcome: 116 URLs returned successful responses. The same two retired historical Enterprise 8.1 and 8.2 pages remained unavailable with HTTP 403; their historical records were preserved without a new verification date.

claimChecks.section: What's Changed; release assets; Full Changelog from 2.12.1 to 2.13.0
claimChecks.qualification: The October 5 component release is not an Observability Cloud SaaS milestone and does not establish compatibility with every Python runtime, framework, image or dependency set.
claimChecks.followUp: Validate OTEL_CONFIG_FILE precedence, locked dependencies and the selected architecture-specific init image in the customer's application environment.

claimChecks.qualification: OTEL_CONFIG_FILE suppresses the distribution's environment-variable defaults, while profiling and callgraphs remain environment-variable-only in this release.
claimChecks.followUp: Retain explicit configuration-precedence validation; do not portray declarative configuration as complete environment-variable replacement.

claimChecks.qualification: SPLUNK_OTEL_SYSTEM_METRICS_ENABLED was never read by the runtime. Removing it from metadata does not change runtime behavior; OTEL_PYTHON_DISABLED_INSTRUMENTATIONS=system_metrics is the effective disable path.
claimChecks.followUp: Keep the correction visible without misclassifying it as a removed runtime capability.
